ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms changed behaviors, updated cases and the follow-output flag are declared; it does not compare tests with code.
offer: Update tests from the intended contract when behavior changes. Copying new output into old assertions without a behavioral decision creates circular evidence.

minimal.reason: List the behaviors that changed. Tests cannot follow a change nobody named, so state each one.

mid.reason: List the test cases updated for those behaviors. A changed behavior with no updated case leaves stale tests, so map each.

maximal.reason: Set tests following output blindly to false. Copying new output into old assertions makes circular evidence, so decide the intended behavior first.
